Fields of a metadata.yml list section that have no value

Source: R/test_functions.R
util_list_empty_fields.Rd

An empty field (replicates: with nothing after it, or ~) reads as NULL, and an empty collection ([] or {}) as a zero-length list. traits.use::convert_list_to_df2() turns either into a zero-length column, which recycles the entry's other columns down to zero rows, so the whole entry is dropped from the build without a message (#307). An explicit .na is a value, checked like any other, so it is not reported.

util_list_empty_fields(entries)

Arguments

entries

A list section of metadata.yml, such as traits

Value

A character vector naming each empty field and its entry; empty if there are none
